# UNO Rules
## Overview

UNO is the classic family card game where players take turns matching a card in their hand with the current card shown on top of the discard pile by color, number, or symbol. Be the first to empty your hand — but don't forget to yell "UNO!" when you're down to your last card.
## Game Objective

In UNO, you are racing everyone else to empty a hand of colorful cards. Your goal is to match the discard pile by color, number, or symbol and be the first player with no cards left.
## Components

112 cards (classic 108 + 4 new Wild cards):

| Color | Number cards | Action cards |
|-------|-------------|--------------|
| Blue | 1× 0, 2× each 1-9 | 2× Skip, 2× Reverse, 2× Draw Two |
| Green | 1× 0, 2× each 1-9 | 2× Skip, 2× Reverse, 2× Draw Two |
| Red | 1× 0, 2× each 1-9 | 2× Skip, 2× Reverse, 2× Draw Two |
| Yellow | 1× 0, 2× each 1-9 | 2× Skip, 2× Reverse, 2× Draw Two |
| Wild | — | 4× Wild, 4× Wild Draw Four, 1× Wild Swap Hands OR Wild Shuffle Hands, 3× Wild Customizable |
## Setup

1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal **7 cards** to each player.
3. Place the remaining deck face down as the Draw Pile.
4. Turn over the top card to start the Discard Pile.

**Special first card rules:**
- **Wild** — First player chooses the color to begin play.
- **Wild Draw Four** — Shuffle it back and draw a new card.
- **Skip** — First player (left of dealer) is skipped.
- **Reverse** — Dealer goes first; play direction reverses.
- **Draw Two** — First player draws 2 cards and loses their turn.
## How to Play

![Discard is a red 7; a blue 7 matches by number](/images/rules/uno/turn-flow.svg)
On your turn, play **one** card from your hand that matches the top discard by:
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-1 -->
  **Color** — Same color
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-2 -->
  **Number** — Same number
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-3 -->
  **Symbol** — Same action symbol
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-4 -->
  **Wild cards** — Can always be played

If you cannot (or choose not to) play, draw **one** card from the Draw Pile. You may play it immediately if it matches; otherwise your turn ends.

> You may only play **one** card per turn. You cannot stack multiple action cards in the same turn.
### Calling UNO!

When playing your **second-to-last card** (leaving one card in hand), you must call out **"UNO!"** If caught by another player before the next player takes their turn, you must draw **2 penalty cards**. You must call UNO every time you return to having just one card.
## Action Cards

![Skip, reverse, and draw two](/images/rules/uno/action-cards.svg)
| Card | Effect |
|------|--------|
| **Skip** | Next player loses their turn |
| **Reverse** | Reverses direction of play (2-player: acts like Skip) |
| **Draw Two (+2)** | Next player draws 2 cards AND loses their turn |
| **Wild** | Choose any color; can be played at any time |
| **Wild Draw Four (+4)** | Choose any color; next player draws 4 AND loses their turn |
| **Wild Swap Hands** | Choose any color; swap your entire hand with any player |
| **Wild Shuffle Hands** | Choose any color; collect all hands, shuffle, redeal evenly |
| **Wild Customizable** | Choose any color; effect agreed upon by players before the game |
### The +4 Challenge Rule

You may ONLY play a Wild Draw Four if you have **no cards matching the current color**. If challenged:
1. The next player may accept or challenge.
2. If challenged, you must show your hand.
3. You **are** holding a matching color card → **you** draw 4 cards instead.
4. You **are not** holding a matching color card → the challenger draws **6 cards** instead.
### Wild Swap Hands

Swap your entire hand with any player of your choice. If this is your last card, treat it as a normal Wild to end the game (no swap occurs).
### Wild Shuffle Hands

Collect **all players'** hands, shuffle them together, and deal one-by-one starting from your left clockwise until no cards remain. Some players may end up with more/fewer cards. If this is your last card, treat it as a normal Wild to end the game.
## Two-Player Rules

When playing with only 2 players:
- <!-- rule-item: two-player-rules-item-1 -->
  **Reverse** → Acts like Skip (opponent loses their turn)
- <!-- rule-item: two-player-rules-item-2 -->
  **Skip** → You may immediately play another card
- <!-- rule-item: two-player-rules-item-3 -->
  **Draw Two / Wild Draw Four** → After opponent draws, play immediately resumes on your turn
## Scoring

![Empty your hand; leftover cards score; first to 500](/images/rules/uno/scoring.svg)
Points are scored from all cards remaining in opponents' hands:

| Card Type | Points |
|-----------|--------|
| Number cards 0-9 | Face value |
| Skip / Reverse / Draw Two | 20 |
| Wild / Wild Draw Four | 50 |
| Wild Swap Hands / Wild Customizable | 40 |

First player to reach **500 points** wins the game.
## Draw Pile Depletion

If the Draw Pile runs out and no one has won, take the Discard Pile (keeping the top card), shuffle it, and flip it over to form a new Draw Pile.

  ### Wild
  Choose **any color** to continue play. Can be played on any turn.

  Choose any color; next player draws **4** cards and loses their turn.
  
  **Restriction:** You may only play Wild Draw Four if you have **no cards matching the current color**.

  The next player may **accept** or **challenge**:
  1. If challenged, you must **show your hand**.
  2. If you **do** have a matching color card → **you** draw 4 cards.
  3. If you **don't** have a matching color card → the challenger draws **6** cards.
  
  ### Wild Swap Hands
  Choose any color; swap your entire hand with any player of your choice. If this is your last card, treat it as a normal Wild to end the game (no swap occurs).
  
  ### Wild Shuffle Hands
  Choose any color; collect **all players'** hands, shuffle them together, and redeal evenly starting from your left. If this is your last card, treat it as a normal Wild to end the game.

  Choose any color; the effect is agreed upon by all players before the game begins.

  - [Action Cards](#flow-action-cards)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-uno-call -->
  **UNO Call**

  When you play your **second-to-last card**, you must call out **"UNO!"** before the next player begins their turn.
  
  **Penalty:** If another player catches you failing to say UNO before the next turn starts, you must draw **2 penalty cards**.
  
  **Tip:** Call UNO immediately when you play that card — don't wait!

  Related topics: 
  - [Your Turn](#flow-turn)
  - [Scoring](#flow-scoring)
  - [Winning](#flow-winning)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-scoring -->
  **Scoring**

  When a player empties their hand, they **win the round**. Score points from all cards remaining in opponents' hands:
  
  | Card Type | Points |
  |-----------|--------|
  | Number cards 0–9 | Face value |
  | Skip / Reverse / Draw Two | 20 |
  | Wild / Wild Draw Four | 50 |
  | Wild Swap Hands / Wild Customizable | 40 |
  
  The round winner records the total. Play multiple rounds until someone reaches **500 points**.

  ![Empty your hand; leftover cards score; first to 500](/images/rules/uno/scoring.svg)

  Related topics: 
  - [Winning](#flow-winning)
  - [Your Turn](#flow-turn)
  - [Setup](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-winning -->
  **Winning**

  ### Standard Game
  First player to reach **500 points** across multiple rounds wins the game.
  
  ### Quick Play (Alternative)
  Play a single round — first player to empty their hand wins immediately. No cumulative scoring needed.
  
  ### Round Win
  The first player to play their last card wins the round and collects points from opponents' remaining hands.

  Related topics: 
  - [Scoring](#flow-scoring)
  - [Setup](#flow-setup)
  - [Your Turn](#flow-turn)

# UNO 规则
## 概述

UNO 是经典的家庭卡牌游戏。玩家轮流打出手牌，需要与弃牌堆顶部的牌在颜色、数字或符号上匹配。率先清空手牌即可获胜——但当手牌只剩最后一张时，别忘了大喊"UNO！"
## 游戏目标

在《UNO》中，你和其他人比赛清空一手彩色牌。你的目标是按颜色、数字或符号接上弃牌堆，并抢先出完手牌。
## 组件

112 张牌（经典版 108 张 + 4 张新万能牌）：

| 颜色 | 数字牌 | 功能牌 |
|------|--------|--------|
| 蓝 | 1× 0，2× 各 1-9 | 2× 跳过，2× 反转，2× +2 |
| 绿 | 1× 0，2× 各 1-9 | 2× 跳过，2× 反转，2× +2 |
| 红 | 1× 0，2× 各 1-9 | 2× 跳过，2× 反转，2× +2 |
| 黄 | 1× 0，2× 各 1-9 | 2× 跳过，2× 反转，2× +2 |
| 万能 | — | 4× 万能牌，4× 万能 +4，1× 万能交换手牌 或 万能重洗手牌，3× 万能自定义牌 |
## 准备

1. 洗匀牌堆。
2. 每位玩家发 **7 张**牌。
3. 剩余牌面向下作为抽牌堆。
4. 翻开最上面一张牌作为弃牌堆起点。

**首张牌特殊规则：**
- **万能牌** — 起始玩家选择颜色开始游戏。
- **万能 +4** — 洗回牌堆重新翻。
- **跳过** — 起始玩家（庄家左侧）被跳过。
- **反转** — 庄家先出牌，方向变为逆时针。
- **+2** — 起始玩家抽 2 张并跳过回合。
## 游戏流程

![弃牌是红 7，手牌蓝 7 因数字相同可以出](/images/rules/uno/turn-flow.svg)
轮到你的回合时，打出**一张**与弃牌堆顶部匹配的手牌：
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-1 -->
  **颜色** — 颜色相同
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-2 -->
  **数字** — 数字相同
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-3 -->
  **符号** — 功能符号相同
- <!-- rule-item: how-to-play-item-4 -->
  **万能牌** — 随时可打出

如果无法出牌（或不想出），从抽牌堆抽**一张**。抽到的牌若符合条件可立即打出，否则回合结束。

> 每回合只能出**一张**牌。不能在同一回合叠加多张功能牌。
### 喊 UNO!

打出**倒数第二张**手牌时（手中只剩一张时），必须大声喊出 **"UNO!"**。如果在下一位玩家出牌前被其他玩家指出未喊，罚抽 **2 张**。每次回到只剩一张牌的状态都需要再次喊 UNO。
## 功能牌

![跳过、反转、+2 三种功能牌](/images/rules/uno/action-cards.svg)
| 卡牌 | 效果 |
|------|------|
| **跳过** | 下一位玩家跳过回合 |
| **反转** | 改变出牌方向（2 人局效果等同跳过） |
| **+2** | 下家抽 2 张并跳过回合 |
| **万能牌** | 指定接下来的颜色，可在任何时候打出 |
| **万能 +4** | 指定颜色，下家抽 4 张并跳过回合 |
| **万能交换手牌** | 指定颜色，并与任一玩家交换全部手牌 |
| **万能重洗手牌** | 指定颜色，收集所有人手牌洗匀后重新平均分配 |
| **万能自定义牌** | 指定颜色，效果由玩家开局前协商决定 |
### +4 质疑规则

万能 +4 只能在你**没有当前颜色牌**时打出。如果被质疑：
1. 下家可选择接受或质疑。
2. 若被质疑，你必须展示手牌。
3. 你**有**当前颜色的牌 → **你**抽 4 张作为惩罚。
4. 你**没有**当前颜色的牌 → 质疑者抽 **6 张**作为惩罚。
### 万能交换手牌

将你的手牌与你选定的任一玩家交换。如果这是你的最后一张牌，当作普通万能牌打出即可结束游戏（不执行交换）。
### 万能重洗手牌

收集**所有玩家**的手牌，洗匀后从打出者左侧开始逐张重新分配，直到牌发完。部分玩家可能多/少一张。如果是最后一张牌，当作普通万能牌结束游戏。
## 双人规则

2 人对局时规则微调：
- <!-- rule-item: two-player-rules-item-1 -->
  **反转** → 效果等同跳过（对手跳过回合）
- <!-- rule-item: two-player-rules-item-2 -->
  **跳过** → 打出后可以立即再出一张牌
- <!-- rule-item: two-player-rules-item-3 -->
  **+2 / 万能 +4** → 对手抽牌后，轮次立即回到你
## 计分

![先打空手牌；对手剩牌记分，先到 500](/images/rules/uno/scoring.svg)
根据所有对手剩余手牌计分：

| 卡牌类型 | 分值 |
|---------|------|
| 数字牌 0-9 | 面值 |
| 跳过 / 反转 / +2 | 20 |
| 万能牌 / 万能 +4 | 50 |
| 万能交换手牌 / 万能自定义牌 | 40 |

率先累计达到 **500 分**的玩家赢得整场游戏。
## 抽牌堆用完

如果抽牌堆耗尽且无人获胜，将弃牌堆（保留顶牌）洗匀翻面作为新的抽牌堆继续游戏。

  指定颜色，收集**所有玩家**的手牌，洗匀后从左侧开始逐张重新分配。如果是最后一张牌，当作普通万能牌结束游戏。
  
  ### 万能自定义牌
  指定颜色，效果由玩家开局前协商决定。

  相关主题：
  - [功能牌](#flow-action-cards)
  - [你的回合](#flow-turn)
  - [UNO 规则](#flow-uno-call)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-uno-call -->
  **UNO 规则**

  打出**倒数第二张**手牌时，必须在下一位玩家开始回合前大声喊出 **"UNO!"**。
  
  **惩罚：** 若其他玩家在你喊出 UNO 之前抢先指出，罚抽 **2 张**。
  
  **提示：** 打出该牌时立即喊 UNO，不要拖延！

  相关主题：
  - [你的回合](#flow-turn)
  - [计分](#flow-scoring)
  - [获胜条件](#flow-winning)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-scoring -->
  **计分**

  有玩家出完手牌时，该玩家**赢得该局**。根据所有对手剩余手牌计分：
  
  | 卡牌类型 | 分值 |
  |---------|------|
  | 数字牌 0–9 | 面值 |
  | 跳过 / 反转 / +2 | 20 |
  | 万能牌 / 万能 +4 | 50 |
  | 万能交换手牌 / 万能自定义牌 | 40 |
  
  该局获胜者记录总分。多局累计，先达到 **500 分**者胜。

  ![先打空手牌；对手剩牌记分，先到 500](/images/rules/uno/scoring.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [获胜条件](#flow-winning)
  - [你的回合](#flow-turn)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-winning -->
  **获胜条件**

  ### 标准模式
  多局累计，先达到 **500 分**的玩家赢得整场游戏。
  
  ### 快速模式（替代玩法）
  只玩一局，率先清空手牌的玩家直接获胜，无需累计计分。
  
  ### 单局获胜
  率先打出最后一张牌的玩家赢得该局，并收取对手剩余手牌的分值。

## 快速查阅
从这里快速跳到相关规则条目。

- <!-- rule-item: flow-setup -->
  **游戏准备**

  1. **洗匀** 112 张牌（经典 108 张 + 4 张新万能牌）。
  2. 每位玩家**发 7 张**牌。
  3. 剩余牌面朝下作为**抽牌堆**。
  4. 翻开最上面一张作为**弃牌堆**起点。
  
  **首张牌特殊规则：**
  - **万能牌** → 起始玩家选择颜色开始游戏
  - **万能 +4** → 洗回牌堆重新翻
  - **跳过** → 起始玩家（庄家左侧）被跳过
  - **反转** → 庄家先出牌，方向变为逆时针
  - **+2** → 起始玩家抽 2 张并跳过回合

  相关主题：
  - [你的回合](#flow-turn)
  - [功能牌](#flow-action-cards)
  - [万能牌](#flow-wild-cards)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-turn -->
  **你的回合**

  轮到你时，打出**一张**与弃牌堆顶部匹配的牌：
  - **颜色** — 颜色相同
  - **数字** — 数字相同
  - **符号** — 功能符号相同
  - **万能牌** — 随时可打出
  
  **无法出牌？** 从抽牌堆抽**1 张**。若符合条件可立即打出，否则回合结束。
  
  游戏按当前方向继续，直到有人出完手牌。

  ![弃牌是红 7，手牌蓝 7 因数字相同可以出](/images/rules/uno/turn-flow.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [功能牌](#flow-action-cards)
  - [万能牌](#flow-wild-cards)
  - [UNO 规则](#flow-uno-call)
  - [游戏准备](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-action-cards -->
  **功能牌**

  | 卡牌 | 效果 |
  |------|------|
  | **跳过** | 下一位玩家跳过回合 |
  | **反转** | 改变出牌方向（2 人局效果等同跳过） |
  | **+2** | 下家抽 2 张并跳过回合 |
  
  蓝、绿、红、黄各色各有 2 张跳过、2 张反转、2 张 +2。
  
  功能牌可在与弃牌堆顶部**颜色**或**符号**匹配时打出。

  ![跳过、反转、+2 三种功能牌](/images/rules/uno/action-cards.svg)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-wild-cards -->
  **万能牌**

  ### 万能牌
  指定**任意颜色**继续游戏。随时可打出。
  
  ### 万能 +4
  指定颜色，下家抽**4 张**并跳过回合。
  
  **限制：** 万能 +4 只能在你**没有当前颜色牌**时打出。
  
  ### +4 质疑规则
  下家可以选择**接受**或**质疑**：
  1. 若被质疑，你必须**展示手牌**。
  2. 如果你**有**当前颜色的牌 → **你**抽 4 张。
  3. 如果你**没有**当前颜色的牌 → 质疑者抽 **6 张**。
  
  ### 万能交换手牌
  指定颜色，并与任一玩家交换全部手牌。如果这是你的最后一张牌，当作普通万能牌打出即可结束游戏（不执行交换）。
  
  ### 万能重洗手牌
  指定颜色，收集**所有玩家**的手牌，洗匀后从左侧开始逐张重新分配。如果是最后一张牌，当作普通万能牌结束游戏。
  
  ### 万能自定义牌
  指定颜色，效果由玩家开局前协商决定。
